answer:
I don't know the exact figure for the current Windows release, so I can't give you a reliable number. The installer size and the installed footprint have changed across versions, and the Windows build bundles GPU runtime libraries that make it larger than the core binary alone.

Some details I'm more confident about:

- The default install location is under your user profile, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Ollama`, and it doesn't require admin rights.
- Models are stored separately, by default in `%USERPROFILE%\.ollama\models`. You can move them with the `OLLAMA_MODELS` environment variable, which is useful if your system drive is short on space.

To get an accurate number, check the size of the download on the Ollama website or its GitHub releases page, or check the installed size under Settings > Apps after installing. Make sure you have a few GB of free space to be safe.
